name: Shopify
description: Existing SSMA Shopify adapter. Live mode is read-only development-store identity and catalog verification; simulator fulfillment retains its governed workflow.

actions.label: Approve Master observation updates
actions.confirmation: Approve this current order’s financial observations and future updates for Master analysis? No provider order is changed.

actions.label: Approve condition notifications
actions.confirmation: Approve publication of this condition and future episodes to Master? Master monitoring policy separately controls notification delivery.

catalogObservationMaxAgeSeconds.description: Maximum age of a successful cached external catalog observation. A current observation grants no stock, price, fulfillment or production authority.

catalogReadEnabled.description: Permit governed read-only access to successful cached catalog observations. This does not enable order import, fulfillment or production.
